notes: Adds a File > Language menu and rebuilds the interface immediately when the language changes.
Translates the Search or select a hack prompt and keeps its result list attached when the app moves between monitors.
Keeps the full banner composition readable when the app is not maximized.
Separates SNI and QUsb2Snes setup so either service can be configured and used independently.
Adds in-app SNI, QUsb2Snes, and RetroArch installation and discovery, including recommended RetroArch core setup.
Improves Setup & Health Check so a working RetroArch connection is reported as ready.
Limits Play Random Hack to downloaded, launchable games and reliably starts the next game timer.
Keeps resumed save-slot deaths and game time working, and no longer treats castle destruction as game completion.
Removes the duplicate About & Updates command from File; it remains available from Help.
Removes the local database path from the Statistics header for safer screenshots and streams.
Credits tester Jole_12 and thanks them for their testing, feedback, and contributions.
Includes refreshed privacy-safe feature screenshots and expanded regression coverage.
Distributes unsigned installers with SHA-256 verification and rollback-capable in-app updates.
